rules: The ball must be kicked with the foot or leg.
Fielders can get a runner out by tagging them with the ball or hitting them with the ball below the shoulders.
Force outs occur when a runner must advance to the next base and the fielder touches the base with the ball.
Strikes are called for swings and misses, or pitches that roll through the strike zone without being kicked.
No leading off or stealing bases; runners must stay on the base until the ball is kicked.

key_terms.definition: An out made when a runner is forced to move to the next base and the fielder touches that base while holding the ball.
The set sequence in which players on the offensive team must take their turn to kick.
When a fly ball is caught, a runner must touch their original base after the catch before trying to advance.

global_connections.description: While popular in American schools, kickball has grown into massive adult social leagues across the United States and is frequently played as a community-building sport.

unit_plan.skills: Kicking technique, running through 1st base, and force play logic
unit_plan.games: Base running relays / Lead-up kicking drills, scrimmage
unit_plan.discussion: What is the Spirit of the Game?
